subject.title: [Feature]: Allow Codex harness configured app-server provider IDs

question: Should the bundled Codex plugin accept an advanced `appServer.providerIds` allowlist for custom Codex `model_providers`, or should custom Codex app-server provider routing stay out of OpenClaw config for now?
rationale: This is a new config and provider-routing surface, and repository policy sets a high bar for config additions even though the upstream Codex dependency supports custom providers.

options.title: Review the paired PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101587 as the focused implementation path, requiring clear docs, schema validation, and upgrade/security proof before merge.

options.title: Reject the config surface
options.body: Keep the harness limited to `codex` and `openai`, and ask operators to use the documented `openai/*` route or a future broader provider-routing design.

options.title: Defer for design
options.body: Leave the issue open for a narrower plugin API or Codex-provider mapping proposal before accepting any new config key.

recommendation.title: Review the paired PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101587 as the focused implementation path, requiring clear docs, schema validation, and upgrade/security proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex harness and OpenAI provider identity work makes this the best available routing owner for the product choice.
